title: Komorebi Practice in Context — Grammar Coverage Checklist

policy.unitOfTracking: Tracked by (renshuuGrammarId, meaningIndex) because a single Renshuu grammar ID can cover multiple distinct meanings/uses.
policy.taughtRule: A grammar meaning is counted as taught (taught: true) ONLY when it is linked to at least one validated primary question and distinct follow-up exercise in a pack.
policy.sourceLicensing: Local Renshuu exports are used strictly as a local planning reference. All published explanations, sentences, glosses, distractors, follow-ups, and worked examples in data/context-pack-*.json are original material authored for Komorebi.
policy.resumableWorkflow: Rerunning scripts/validate-context-packs.mjs validates all packs and checklist invariants and skips regenerating packs whose status is live, reviewed, or validated.
